scope.surface: 188px Composer with a 540px inline Files panel, compact overflow controls, workspace and branch context, and file-detail navigation

productLoss: At 1024x820 the viewport remained above the 980px sheet breakpoint, leaving only 188px for the Composer while the 540px Files panel stayed inline.
The Web workspace and branch controls overlapped by 79.21875px inside a 144px context strip; Lynx overlapped by 33px inside a 143px strip.
Lynx compact controls always expanded toward the right, so a 148px menu anchored at x=434.890625 extended beyond the 483px center-column boundary.
productRepair: The shared BranchToolbar now allocates both workspace and branch controls as min-width-zero flexible children instead of restoring intrinsic desktop width at the viewport md breakpoint.
Lynx context labels and control wrappers now shrink and ellipsize within the context strip.
The Lynx compact controls menu aligns its trailing edge to the trigger when the measured center column is below 300px.
The Lynx file-detail Back action is visible in both inline and sheet modes, and coarse whole-line Markdown highlighting no longer colors ordinary prose.
harnessLoss: The 1024px Web compact menu closes before final screenshot capture while Lynx remains open. That authority-state instability is retained as harness/product-state debt; only the measured Lynx menu containment geometry is used.
The first Native dark and light Files runs produced identical light screenshots because the fixture used the obsolete theme field and the verifier checked theme only in Composer-specific flows.

The packaged verifier now writes themePreference into its copied fixture and requires .app-theme-root data-theme to match every requested expected theme. The invalid screenshots receive no product credit.
intentionalPlatformDelta: Web keeps a persistent desktop explorer and therefore has no Back button. Lynx keeps the explorer in inline mode but also exposes Back because its sheet mode replaces the explorer entirely.
Lynx Native uses coarse line-level Markdown tones rather than the Web Pierre editor's token-level syntax grammar and gutter utilities.
acceptedRenderingNoise: The final Web Composer is 188px wide and Lynx is 187px; the inline right-panel boundary differs by one pixel.
At the narrowest allocation Lynx reduces the workspace control to its icon while retaining the branch control; Web gives both controls 64px.
classification.evidenceBoundary: The new Browser state uses one immutable snapshot, selected thread, dark theme, 1024x820 viewport, 540px inline Files panel, shipping Web and Lynx-for-Web bundles, and zero console errors. File-detail dark and light runs use 1280x820 paired shipping artifacts and real open, switch, and Lynx Back inputs. Exact Native dark and light use one production bundle, copied fixtures with identical database hashes, explicit theme identity, measured DevTool touches, main transport advancement, zero renderer errors, disposed state, and zero owned or orphaned agent-browser processes.

fileDetail.materialAttribution: No material residual is updated. The Web authority bundle and pixels changed between the previous and current captures, and raw full-frame MAE did not improve monotonically.

invalidThemeRuns.reason: Both requested themes rendered light because the copied fixture lacked themePreference and the verifier did not assert the root theme. These runs are excluded from product attribution.
